title: Étale, affine pro-étale and weakly étale morphisms
statement:
Let $u\colon U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes.

1. If $u$ is étale, then $u$ is weakly étale [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism].
2. If $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and $u$ is affine pro-étale, i.e. $U=\operatorname{Spec}B$
   with $R\to B$ ind-étale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], then $u$ is weakly étale.
3. If $u$ is weakly étale and locally of finite presentation, then $u$ is étale.
4. On affine charts $U\supset\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R\subset X$, $u$ is
   weakly étale if and only if $R\to B$ and the multiplication $B\otimes_RB\to B$ are flat.

proof.text: For clause 1 install Etale f as an instance and apply Mathlib's proved WeaklyEtale instance. It supplies flatness of f and flatness of its open-immersion diagonal.

For clause 2 install the assumed Algebra.IndEtale R B instance. The already proved source-library instance Algebra.IndEtale.weaklyEtale (WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndWeaklyEtale) provides Algebra.WeaklyEtale R B. Apply weaklyEtale_SpecMap_algebraMap_iff from the recorded definition node, yielding weak etaleness of the exact spectrum map. This reuses the proved ind-etale implication directly without importing the large principal-Zariski stability conjunction.

For clause 3 the already proved source-library instance locallyOfFinitePresentation_diagonal (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.FinitePresentation) gives local finite presentation of the diagonal. Its proof uses cancellation of local finite presentation for diagonal followed by pullback.fst, whose composite is the identity. The diagonal is split mono and is flat by weak etaleness. Apply IsOpenImmersion.of_flat_of_mono to obtain an open diagonal. Mathlib's open-diagonal instance gives FormallyUnramified f, and Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat combines it with flatness and the original local finite presentation. No quasi-compactness, separatedness or finite presentation of the original morphism is added.

source.place: locallyOfFinitePresentation_diagonal and locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_comp (Stacks 02FV); Mathlib FlatMono IsOpenImmersion.of_flat_of_mono; Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat

proof.text: For clause 4 use the already proved WeaklyEtale.hasRingHomProperty in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.WeaklyEtale. It identifies weak etaleness with affineLocally RingHom.WeaklyEtale, by the affine-spectrum diagonal/tensor calculation and Zariski locality. Rewrite affineLocally_iff_forall_isAffineOpen, obtaining the condition on all affine chart pairs. In each direction introduce exactly the appLE-induced algebra structure. RingHom.WeaklyEtale is definitionally Algebra.WeaklyEtale for this algebra, whose fields are module flatness and tensor multiplication flatness. Convert the first field with RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff and keep the second unchanged. Constructing these fields proves the converse as well. Both quantifications have exactly the original affine opens and containment, with no extra ring hypotheses.
